articles.title: Extraction Tier 3 Plan Hardened Through Live Codebase Validation; 12 Architectural Issues Resolved Before Implementation
articles.body:
A comprehensive GitNexus-driven review of the extraction-tier3-implementation-plan identified and resolved twelve critical architectural issues, preventing costly rework downstream. The plan was validated against the live codebase with systematic class coverage tracking and design decision approval from Victor. Key architectural decisions approved include: proper persistence layering via PersistStep→use_cases, restoration of original Contrato→Kit sequencing, Celery retry semantics with max_retries=3, and bundled test migration strategy.

The plan was patched to v0.2.0 with 19 sequential edits addressing event typing fixes, step ordering restoration, and introduction of a MultipleCCBGuardStep guard. The design was simplified versus the original plan: nine support classes (gates, strategies, CascadingStep) remain deferred, reducing scope while maintaining architectural integrity. This hardened blueprint now serves as the authoritative specification for extraction tier 3 implementation, with all major design trade-offs explicitly documented and approved.
